About us

Certified Tree Care Professionals Serving Connecticut with Trusted Arborist Services

Erick’s Tree Services is a professional tree care company serving residential and commercial properties throughout Connecticut.

With years of hands-on experience, our team specializes in safe and efficient tree removal, trimming, stump grinding, and emergency storm cleanup.

We are committed to delivering reliable service with a strong focus on safety, professionalism, and long-term customer trust. Every project is handled with care, precision, and respect for your property.

Our goal is simple: provide high-quality tree services that keep your property safe, clean, and well maintained.

How it works

Simple, Safe & Efficient Tree Service Process

At Erick's Tree Services, we make it easy to get the tree services you need without hassle. It's easy and here is our process.

  1. 01

    Book your request

    Contact our team by phone or online form. We'll gather basic details about your project and schedule a convenient time for an assessment.

  2. 02

    On-Site Evaluation

    Our experts visit your property to evaluate the situation, identify risks, and determine the best and safest approach for the work required.

  3. 03

    Professional Service Execution

    Our trained crew completes the job using professional equipment and strict safety standards, ensuring efficient and precise results.

  4. 04

    Cleanup & Final Inspection

    We thoroughly clean the site and perform a final inspection to make sure everything is safe, clear, and left in excellent condition.
